info.label: Permit ID
info.notes: This is a unique identifier for each permit. Permits may appear in the table multiple times since this table breaks permits down into the associated street closures.

info.label: Permit type
info.notes: The nature of the permit. These values are just a few words and are selected from a list of options.

info.label: Work Description
info.notes: Description of services performed by company

info.label: Work type
info.notes: A basic description of the work necessitating the permit. These values are just a few words and are selected from a list of options.

info.label: Commercial or residential
info.notes: A categorical variable describing if the work is taking place on residential or commercial property (the only values allowed are COMMERCIAL, RESIDENTIAL, or null).

info.label: Total project value
info.notes: The projected cost of the project. This is used to determine the cost of the permit, with more expensive jobs costing more.

info.label: Issue date
info.notes: The date that the permit was issued.

info.label: Parcel number
info.notes: Alphanumeric identifier for the Allegheny County land parcel the where work takes place.

info.label: Street address
info.notes: Building number and street. When a structure is demolished the county removes the building number. The structure technically has no address at that point. These properties have a building number of zero.
